bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the self-similarity (mean pairwise cosine similarity) of image embeddings within racial groups, and evaluating the frequency at which the model prefers an unmarked 'person' text label over specific race or ethnicity labels.

Measuring the self-similarity of image embeddings for male versus female individuals, and evaluating the frequency at which the model prefers an unmarked 'person' text label over specific gender labels.

Measuring the self-similarity of image embeddings within specific age ranges, and evaluating the frequency at which the model prefers an unmarked 'person' text label over descriptive age-range labels.

Comparing representational self-similarity and markedness (label preferences) across combined demographic categories, such as comparing White Male individuals with Black Female individuals across various age ranges.
